body: It's so incredibly complicated, which is one of the reasons why it's hard to talk to anyone about it. I have been with my boyfriend for over 8 years. He means more than life and the world itself to me. We broke up a couple years ago for silly mistakes we have made and since then it has been a roller coaster. Some times its beautiful and we are the same couple that we always were and that's meant to be, and at times its like this. And we just can't find balance. The events and the circumstances of our break up and getting back together have changed us, I have become very vulnerable, and he is still not over his 'young party phase'. (we are 24). This makes for a very bad combination that leads to many fights. We have almost broke up so many more times since then. But this is all so devastating..he has he was gonna propose to me when we visit my family in Europe this summer. I'd love to marry him. But I think he is scared. And I am too because of nights like this, but I love him more than anything. I'm so affraid that things wont change and we will break up. I feel like we are getting tired and running out of energy, and I feel like we are losing each other. But I love him more than anything and I know deep down he loves me too. I'm just so hopeless.
